paper_title: Towards Predicting Any Human Trajectory In Context
caption: Performance of random example selection and the proposed STES at varying numbers of in-context examples.
model_annotation: This line chart compares the performance of two example selection strategies—ST-ES and Random—as measured by minimum ADE₂₀ (in units of distance) across varying numbers of in-context examples, ranging from 0 to 8. The x-axis, labeled “Number of Examples,” is linearly scaled from 0 to 8 with tick marks at integer intervals. The y-axis, labeled “minADE₂₀ (←),” is linearly scaled from 8.80 to 10.20 with tick marks at intervals of 0.40. The ST-ES strategy is represented by a solid blue line with circular markers, starting at a value of 10.20 at 0 examples and decreasing to 8.88 at 8 examples, showing a general downward trend with minor fluctuations. The Random strategy is represented by an orange line with circular markers, starting at 9.80 at 0 examples and remaining relatively stable around 9.40 to 9.60 for the remainder of the range, with minor fluctuations.

model_annotations.English: This line plot compares the performance of two example selection strategies—ST-ES and Random—as measured by minADE₂₀ (in meters) across varying numbers of in-context examples, ranging from 0 to 8. The x-axis, labeled “Number of Examples,” uses a linear scale with integer tick marks at 0, 2, 4, 6, and 8. The y-axis, labeled “minADE₂₀ (m),” uses a linear scale ranging from 8.80 to 10.20, with tick marks spaced at 0.40-unit intervals. The ST-ES strategy is represented by a blue line with circular markers and a solid line style; it begins at a high value of 10.20 at 0 examples, then decreases sharply to 9.20 at 2 examples, and continues to decline gradually to 8.88 at 8 examples. The Random strategy is represented by an orange line with circular markers and a dashed line style; it starts at 9.80 at 0 examples, then decreases slightly to 9.40 at 2 examples, and remains relatively stable around 9.40 to 9.60 for the remainder of the range, ending at 9.60 at 8 examples.
